turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Doing alright, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start working out again but I can only manage three short sessions a week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's plenty to make progress. Would you rather focus on strength with weights, or on cardio like running and cycling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Nina something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, I'll hold on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, are you using the car tomorrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only in the morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, did you use the last of the butter?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe? I made toast this morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need a whole cup for these cookies.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There might be some in the freezer, check the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, found it. Can you grab me the brown sugar while you're up?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Here. Save me a cookie.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, are you back already?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, the store was quick.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Any decision on strength versus cardio?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Cardio, I think. My stamina is terrible.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then try intervals. Two minutes easy, one minute hard, repeated for about twenty minutes.
